Source actions for pose or explicitly named equipment only: 찌르기, 찌르기, 돌진, 먹빛 일섬.
Exactly ONE enemy, no duplicates or additional characters. Keep the entire silhouette and all tips inside frame with generous transparent margins. No scenery, floor or detached background fragments.
